addhuvasīla.p: [Na+dhuvasīla] (ti) CL=8 Not always having virtue , not always observing the precepts , to observe the precepts only sometimes. A person who doesn't always have virtue, who doesn't always observe the precepts ,who observe the precepts only sometimes.
pn: Addhuvasīla. A youth who stole ornaments to win the daughter of his teacher. He failed in his quest. The story is given in the Sīlavīmaṁsanajātaka. Ja.iii.18-20.
